statement: Water boils at 100°C at sea level.
explanation: At standard atmospheric pressure (101.325 kPa), the boiling point of water is exactly 100°C (212°F).

statement: Humans only use 10% of their brains.
explanation: Neuroimaging studies show that virtually all brain regions are active, and over a single day, essentially 100% of the brain is used at some point.

statement: DNA is shaped like a double helix.
explanation: James Watson and Francis Crick described the double helix structure of DNA in 1953, a model confirmed by Rosalind Franklin's X-ray diffraction data.

statement: Antibiotics are effective against viral infections.
explanation: Antibiotics target bacterial cell structures and processes. They have no effect on viruses, which require antiviral medications or vaccines.

statement: Adult humans have 206 bones.
explanation: Infants are born with approximately 270 to 300 bones. Many of these fuse during childhood and adolescence, leaving adults with 206.

statement: Different regions of the tongue taste different flavours.
explanation: The 'tongue map' is a mistranslation of a 1901 German study. Taste receptors for all five basic tastes exist across all regions of the tongue.

statement: Stomach acid is strong enough to dissolve metals.
explanation: Hydrochloric acid in the stomach has a pH of 1 to 2. At that concentration it can dissolve zinc and, given enough time, even some steel alloys.

statement: Shaving hair makes it grow back thicker and darker.
explanation: Shaving cuts hair at the shaft, creating a blunt tip that can feel coarser. It does not affect the follicle, so it cannot change the colour or rate of growth.

statement: Bananas are mildly radioactive.
explanation: Bananas contain potassium-40, a naturally occurring radioactive isotope of potassium. The dose is minuscule and harmless.

statement: Sound travels faster in water than in air.
explanation: Sound travels at approximately 343 m/s in air but around 1,480 m/s in water, because water molecules are closer together and transmit compressions more efficiently.

statement: Glass is a slow-moving liquid at room temperature.
explanation: Glass is an amorphous solid. Old window panes appear thicker at the bottom due to manufacturing methods of the era, not flow over time.

statement: Humans share approximately 50% of their DNA with bananas.
explanation: The genes we share with bananas are mostly those involved in basic cellular functions such as transcription and cell division.

statement: Helium is the lightest element.
explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest element with an atomic mass of approximately 1.008 u. Helium is the second lightest at 4.003 u.

statement: It takes approximately 8 minutes and 20 seconds for sunlight to reach Earth.
explanation: Light travels at 299,792 km/s. Given the average Earth–Sun distance of about 150 million km, the journey takes 8 minutes and 20 seconds.

statement: Vaccines cause autism.
explanation: The original 1998 study making this claim was retracted and its author lost his medical licence. Dozens of large-scale studies involving millions of children have found no link.

statement: Diamond is the hardest known natural material.
explanation: Diamond scores 10 on the Mohs hardness scale, the maximum value. Its hardness is due to the strong covalent bonding structure in its cubic crystal lattice.

statement: The human body contains more bacterial cells than human cells.
explanation: A 2016 study estimated the ratio of bacteria to human cells is approximately 1.3:1, meaning our body hosts slightly more bacterial than human cells.

statement: Dropping a penny from the Empire State Building would kill a pedestrian.
explanation: A penny weighs about 2.5 grams and is aerodynamically flat. Air resistance limits its terminal velocity to around 40 km/h — enough to sting, but not kill.

statement: Venus is the hottest planet in the solar system.
explanation: Despite being further from the Sun than Mercury, Venus reaches surface temperatures of ~465°C due to a runaway greenhouse effect from its thick CO₂ atmosphere.

statement: There is no gravity in space.
explanation: Gravity extends throughout the universe. Astronauts aboard the ISS experience ~90% of Earth's gravity — they appear weightless because they are in continuous freefall around Earth.

statement: A single sneeze travels at approximately 160 km/h.
explanation: Expelled droplets from a sneeze have been measured at speeds between 140 and 165 km/h (about 100 mph).

statement: All of the universe's matter is concentrated in visible stars and planets.
explanation: Only about 5% of the universe is ordinary (baryonic) matter. About 27% is dark matter and 68% is dark energy, both of which are not directly visible.

statement: Electrons have a negative electric charge.
explanation: By convention established by Benjamin Franklin (though later modified), electrons carry a negative charge of −1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ coulombs.

statement: The speed of light is the same in all materials.
explanation: Light travels at its maximum speed (c ≈ 299,792 km/s) only in a vacuum. In glass it slows to about 200,000 km/s, which is why lenses can bend and focus light.

statement: Absolute zero is the lowest possible temperature.
explanation: Absolute zero (0 K, −273.15°C) is the theoretical lower limit of thermodynamic temperature, at which particles have minimal kinetic energy. It has never been fully achieved.

statement: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
explanation: That is why its chemical formula is H2O.

statement: About 60% of the adult human body is water.
explanation: The exact share varies with age, sex and body composition, but water makes up the majority of body mass.

statement: Light travels at roughly 300,000 kilometres per second in a vacuum.
explanation: The precise value is 299,792,458 metres per second, and nothing with mass can reach it.

statement: Hydrogen is the most abundant element in the universe.
explanation: It makes up roughly 75% of all normal matter by mass, mostly in stars and gas clouds.

statement: Sodium metal reacts violently with water.
explanation: The reaction releases hydrogen gas and heat, which can ignite the gas and cause an explosion.

statement: Mercury is liquid at room temperature.
explanation: Mercury melts at about −39 °C, so it is liquid at ordinary temperatures, unlike almost all other metals.

statement: Plants release oxygen during photosynthesis.
explanation: They use sunlight to turn carbon dioxide and water into sugar, and oxygen is released as a by-product.

statement: Red blood cells carry oxygen using a protein called haemoglobin.
explanation: Haemoglobin contains iron, which binds oxygen in the lungs and releases it in tissues, and gives blood its red colour.

statement: The human heart beats around 100,000 times a day.
explanation: At an average of about 70 beats per minute, that adds up to roughly 100,000 beats every 24 hours.

statement: The speed of sound in air is about 343 metres per second.
explanation: This is at around 20 °C; sound travels faster in warmer air and slower in colder air.

statement: According to Newton's first law, an object in motion stays in motion unless acted on by a force.
explanation: This tendency to keep moving at a constant speed and direction is called inertia.

statement: Atoms are mostly empty space.
explanation: If the nucleus were the size of a marble, the electrons would be hundreds of metres away, with nothing in between.

statement: Glass is made mainly from sand.
explanation: The silica in sand is melted at high temperatures, with additives such as soda and lime, to form common glass.

statement: Light behaves as both a wave and a particle.
explanation: This wave-particle duality is a core idea of quantum mechanics, and is shown by experiments like the double slit.

statement: Einstein's equation E = mc² shows that mass and energy are equivalent.
explanation: A tiny amount of mass corresponds to a huge amount of energy, which is the principle behind nuclear power.

statement: A pH of 7 is neutral.
explanation: Values below 7 are acidic and above 7 are alkaline; pure water sits at about 7 at room temperature.

statement: Humans normally have 23 pairs of chromosomes.
explanation: We inherit one set of 23 from each parent, giving a total of 46 chromosomes in most cells.

statement: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928.
explanation: He noticed that a mould had killed bacteria in one of his culture dishes, leading to the first widely used antibiotic.

statement: Edward Jenner developed the world's first vaccine.
explanation: In 1796 he used material from cowpox sores to protect people against smallpox.

statement: Marie Curie won Nobel Prizes in two different sciences.
explanation: She won the Physics prize in 1903 and the Chemistry prize in 1911.

statement: Diamond and graphite are both made of pure carbon.
explanation: The two materials are very different because their carbon atoms are bonded in different arrangements.

statement: Earth's magnetic field is generated by molten iron moving in its outer core.
explanation: The motion of this liquid metal acts as a dynamo, producing a field that shields us from much of the solar wind.

statement: Mitochondria produce most of a cell's usable energy.
explanation: They make ATP, the molecule cells use as fuel, which is why they're called the 'powerhouse of the cell'.

statement: Dmitri Mendeleev created the first widely recognised periodic table.
explanation: In 1869 he arranged the elements by atomic mass and left gaps for elements that had not yet been discovered.

statement: The periodic table currently contains 118 confirmed elements.
explanation: The last four, nihonium, moscovium, tennessine and oganesson, were officially named in 2016.

statement: The human genome contains about 3 billion base pairs.
explanation: That DNA is packed into the nucleus of nearly every cell, where it would be about two metres long if stretched out.

statement: Pure water is a poor conductor of electricity.
explanation: It's the dissolved ions, such as salts, in everyday water that allow it to carry current.

statement: Rust is iron oxide.
explanation: It forms when iron reacts with oxygen in the presence of water.

statement: Any two humans are about 99.9% genetically identical.
explanation: The tiny remaining difference accounts for all of the genetic variety between individuals.

statement: An adult human body contains roughly 37 trillion cells.
explanation: Estimates differ, but they usually fall at around 30 to 40 trillion cells.

statement: Viruses cannot reproduce without a host cell.
explanation: They must hijack the machinery of a living cell to make copies of themselves.

statement: The Higgs boson was discovered at CERN in 2012.
explanation: The discovery, using the Large Hadron Collider, confirmed the mechanism that gives elementary particles their mass.

statement: Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide.
explanation: It turns directly from a solid into a gas, a process called sublimation, at about −78.5 °C.

statement: Tooth enamel is the hardest substance in the human body.
explanation: It is made almost entirely of minerals but cannot regenerate once it is damaged.

statement: The skin is the largest organ of the human body.
explanation: In adults it covers about 1.5 to 2 square metres and accounts for roughly 15% of body weight.

statement: The brain uses about 20% of the body's energy.
explanation: It makes up only about 2% of our body weight but is very energy-hungry.

statement: Helium was discovered on the Sun before it was found on Earth.
explanation: In 1868, astronomers spotted an unknown spectral line in sunlight, and the element was named after the Greek word for the Sun, helios.

statement: The human liver can regenerate.
explanation: Even after a large part has been removed, the liver can grow back to near its original size.

statement: Time passes slightly faster for satellites in orbit than for people on the ground.
explanation: General relativity predicts that weaker gravity speeds clocks up, and GPS has to correct for this effect.

statement: Humans have only five senses.
explanation: Beyond sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch, we also sense balance, temperature, pain and the position of our body.

statement: Cold weather itself causes the common cold.
explanation: Colds are caused by viruses, though people spend more time indoors together in cold weather, which helps them spread.

statement: Sugar makes children hyperactive.
explanation: Controlled studies have found no link between sugar and hyperactivity in children, and expectations seem to play a major role.

statement: Heavier objects fall faster than lighter ones in a vacuum.
explanation: Without air resistance, all objects fall at the same rate, as astronaut David Scott showed by dropping a hammer and feather on the Moon.

statement: Blood is blue inside your veins until it hits the air.
explanation: Blood is always red; deoxygenated blood is just a darker red, and veins look blue because of how light passes through skin.

statement: You lose most of your body heat through your head.
explanation: The head loses heat in proportion to its surface area, about 7–10% of the body, no more than any other uncovered part.

statement: Thomas Edison invented the electric light bulb entirely on his own.
explanation: Many inventors, including Joseph Swan, worked on it, and Edison improved on earlier designs to make a practical bulb.

statement: Swimming right after eating causes dangerous cramps.
explanation: There is no evidence that eating before swimming increases the risk of drowning.

statement: Hair and fingernails keep growing after death.
explanation: The skin dehydrates and shrinks back, making hair and nails look longer, but no new growth occurs.

statement: Swallowed chewing gum stays in your stomach for seven years.
explanation: Gum can't be digested, but it passes through the digestive system within a few days like other indigestible food.

statement: Reading in dim light permanently damages your eyes.
explanation: It can cause eye strain and tiredness, but it does not cause lasting harm.

statement: Matter exists in only three states: solid, liquid and gas.
explanation: Plasma and Bose-Einstein condensates are also states of matter, and others exist.

statement: The atom is the smallest possible particle.
explanation: Atoms are made of protons, neutrons and electrons, and protons and neutrons are made of quarks.

statement: A scientific theory is just a guess.
explanation: In science, a theory is a well-tested explanation supported by a large body of evidence, such as the theory of gravity or evolution.

statement: Humans evolved from chimpanzees.
explanation: Humans and chimpanzees share a common ancestor that lived about 6 to 7 million years ago, but neither evolved from the other.

statement: Vitamin C prevents you from catching colds.
explanation: Studies show vitamin C does not prevent colds in most people, though it may slightly shorten their duration.

statement: Alcohol warms you up when it's cold.
explanation: Alcohol makes your skin feel warmer by dilating blood vessels, but this actually causes you to lose body heat more quickly.

statement: Diamonds are completely indestructible.
explanation: Diamond is extremely hard but brittle; it can shatter on impact and burns at high temperatures.

statement: Microwave ovens cook food from the inside out.
explanation: Microwaves penetrate only a few centimetres into food, so the outer layers heat first and the heat spreads inward.

statement: Food cooked in a microwave oven becomes radioactive.
explanation: Microwaves are non-ionising radiation and don't make food radioactive.

statement: Mass and weight are the same thing.
explanation: Mass is the amount of matter in an object, while weight is the force of gravity acting on it, which changes with location.

statement: Plants take in carbon dioxide but never release it.
explanation: Plants also respire, using oxygen and releasing carbon dioxide, though they produce more oxygen than they use during the day.

statement: We see because our eyes send out beams of light.
explanation: We see when light from an object enters our eyes; the eye is a receiver and does not emit light.

statement: Magnetic north stays fixed in one place.
explanation: The magnetic north pole drifts, currently by tens of kilometres a year, as the molten core moves.

statement: All bacteria are harmful to humans.
explanation: Most bacteria are harmless, and many, such as those in the gut, are essential for digesting food and staying healthy.

statement: Fat can be turned into muscle with enough exercise.
explanation: Fat and muscle are different tissues; exercise builds muscle and burns fat, but one cannot become the other.

statement: People are either 'left-brained' or 'right-brained'.
explanation: Brain imaging shows that both hemispheres are used together in nearly all tasks, regardless of personality.

statement: Eating turkey makes you sleepy because of the tryptophan it contains.
explanation: Turkey has no more tryptophan than other meats, and big meals, carbohydrates or alcohol are more likely to make you drowsy.

statement: Time passes at the same rate everywhere in the universe.
explanation: Both speed and gravity affect how fast time passes, as shown by Einstein's theories of relativity.

statement: Sunlight consists only of visible light.
explanation: Sunlight also includes ultraviolet and infrared radiation, which we cannot see.

statement: Metals expand when they are cooled.
explanation: Most metals contract when cooled and expand when heated.

statement: Light always travels in a straight line.
explanation: Gravity bends the path of light, as seen in gravitational lensing, and light also bends when passing through different materials.

statement: A vacuum cleaner works by 'sucking' dirt up.
explanation: It lowers the pressure inside, and the higher air pressure outside pushes air and dirt into the machine.

statement: Stress can turn your hair white overnight.
explanation: Hair that has already grown can't change colour in a night; stress can affect pigment-producing cells in new hair, but only over time.

statement: Rosalind Franklin's X-ray images were crucial to discovering the structure of DNA.
explanation: Her 'Photograph 51' revealed the helical shape of DNA, which helped Watson and Crick build their model in 1953.

statement: Water drains in opposite directions in the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
explanation: The Coriolis effect is far too weak to influence a sink or toilet; the drain direction depends on the basin shape and how the water was set in motion.
